description: This Java source file defines the JobServices class, which provides static methods for managing job-related operations such as canceling jobs, retrying cancellations, purging old jobs, and resetting jobs within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: JobServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for job management operations such as canceling, retrying, purging, and resetting jobs within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels a job identified by jobId, updates its cancel timestamp and status, and returns the result.

methods.name: cancelJobRetries
methods.description: Resets the maximum retry count for a specified job, requires permission check.

methods.name: purgeOldJobs
methods.description: Deletes jobs older than a specified number of days from a specified thread pool.

methods.name: resetJob
methods.description: Resets the status and timestamps of a specified job to pending state.
